messages:
Lina R: FYI I'm going to push a config-only tweak for tenant-88 in the 16:45-17:15 PT change window. Aim: blunt a recurring tail risk. Changes: tenant concurrency 25 -> 10, soft request timeout 12s -> 9s, kv_cache warmup ttl 45s -> 90s. Asking SRE to watch during canary.
Devon K: thanks. please run a dry-run and paste the diff. I'll put an alert on 5xx & p99 and watch GC metrics.
deploy-bot: dry-run OK (cset-1024). Config diff summary: +tenants.tenant-88.concurrency=10, +tenants.tenant-88.weight=0.6, +defaults.timeouts.request_ms=9000, +kv_cache.ttl_s=90. No validation errors.
Lina R: dropping snippet for context:
```json
{
  "tenants": {"tenant-88": {"concurrency": 10, "weight": 0.6}},
  "defaults": {"timeouts": {"request_ms": 9000}, "kv_cache": {"ttl_s": 90}}
}
```
Sara M: question 1 7: is weight 0.6 a full traffic ramp or just a shaping factor? Recommend staged weighting 30%->60%->100% over 8m and a 12m observation hold between steps. Also suggest an alert if host GC pause >300ms correlates with 5xx.
Devon K: agree on staging and the GC watch. I'll add a short-lived alert and bump trace sampling for this tenant so we get better error context.
deploy-bot: scheduled canary at 2023-03-15T16:45:00-07:00. Plan: 30%->60%->100% over 8 minutes, 12m hold between steps.
Lina R: kicking it off now.
deploy-bot: canary 30% applied. No immediate failures.
ops-robot: canary hosts healthy. CPU ~40%, memory steady. Observability link: https://console.redwood/obs/cset-1024.
Sara M: p95 up ~70ms, p99 flat. no GC flags yet.
Devon K: small uptick in client retries from this tenant 0.6%->1.1%. Noted but under threshold.
Lina R: moving to 60%.
deploy-bot: rollout 60% complete.
ops-robot: 3 x 502s on inference-12 within 3m; logs show JVM safepoint/GC pauses ~400ms. Host-level p99 spiked.
Sara M: those GC pauses align with the 60% step. recommendation: pause rollout, revert tenant-88 routing to previous concurrency until GC mitigation can land.
Lina R: please hold. Can we test a local remap to route this tenant to fewer coroutines on the host while keeping changes for others?
Devon K: we don't have a hot remap for concurrency per-host quickly. safer to rollback config for tenant-88 now and re-evaluate. Initiating rollback if we see continued 502s.
deploy-bot: rollback triggered by Lina R (revert cset-1024 -> cset-1023). Reverting tenant-88 overrides.
ops-robot: rollback completed. Service health restored, 502s cleared. Memory/GC returns to baseline.
Lina R: rollback confirmed, thanks. Created follow-up ticket RED-451 to investigate GC tuning and try a softer timeout 10s with weight ramp 40%->70% and longer cache warmup next attempt.
Sara M: noted. propose we also try increasing async prefetch and staggering warmup across hosts to avoid synchronized GC.
Devon K: good idea. I'll schedule a short postmortem and plan a safer canary recipe. Thanks all. TL;DR: config-only guardrail for tenant-88 triggered host GC at 60% canary -> paused and rolled back cleanly. Next attempt will be more gradual and include GC mitigation. :white_check_mark:
